headline: Nila Infrastructures bags a fresh order
summary: Nila Infrastructures Limited has formally informed the stock exchange that it has received a new order or contract. The filing indicates ongoing business activity for the company in securing project assignments. Specific financial details, project location, and execution timelines were not disclosed in the preliminary exchange intimation. Indian retail investors tracking small-cap infrastructure stocks should watch for follow-up disclosures regarding the contract value.
why_it_matters: New order inflow supports revenue visibility for the company.

headline: Nila Infrastructures announces a change in management
summary: Nila Infrastructures Limited has officially informed the stock exchanges regarding a change in its management structure.
